{"consolidated_memory":"SERIES OF INCIDENTS: Corrupted Scaffold in cli/commands/init.py (Developer Tooling)
================================================================================

COMMON PATTERN:
- File affected: cli/commands/init.py (developer tooling side)
- Problem signature: corrupted scaffold in init command
- Signal: generated tree missing one file
- Repro: init into a directory that already has a lockfile
- Stack: Python
- Test coverage: tests/cli/test_init.py

FIVE SEPARATE OCCASIONS WITH DISTINCT ROOT CAUSES:

OCCASION 1: [2026-01-15] - Midnight Boundary Issue
- Trigger: jobs scheduled across midnight boundary
- Root cause: missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- Fix: added composite index and backfilled in batches
- PR #2404 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-1
- Result: throughput rose 15% to 928 requests/second

OCCASION 2: [2026-03-07] - Large Tenant Key Count
- Trigger: tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Root cause: config loader reading wrong environment file
- Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR #4066 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-3
- Result: nightly rollup matched source counts for 81 days running

OCCASION 3: [2026-05-14] - Large Payload Size
- Trigger: payloads above roughly 2 megabytes
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware datetime
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR #6218 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-5
- Result: flaky test went from 58 failures per 100 runs to zero

OCCASION 4: [2026-08-28] - Fleet Rolling Restart
- Trigger: after rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: listener registered but never removed
- Fix: removed listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- PR #7869 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-7
- Result: job finished in 19 minutes instead of 3 hours

OCCASION 5: [2026-08-30] - OAuth Sessions
- Trigger: sessions that arrived through OAuth provider
- Root cause: mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: made default empty and built the value per call
- PR #8628 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-8
- Result: cold start dropped 35% to 525 ms"}
